tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i sdom pa'i gnad bye brag tu bshad pa zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rje btsun bla ma rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs snang ba zung 'jug ye shes su/ /dbang gi cho gas thog mar sdom mdzad cing / /rmad byung lam gyis yang yang goms pa las/ /gsang ba sgrub mdzad rje btsun bla ma rgyal/ /rang sems gdod nas spros bral rgyu rgyud dang / /dbang gi ye shes lam gyi lta ba dang / /nyams myong sangs rgyas sa dang ngo bo gcig /rtogs pa'i khyad par zla ba'i dpe yis bstan/ /tshig 'di thos na dri za'i dbyangs ltar snyan/ /bsam na bdud rtsi myang ltar yid rab tshim/ /bsgoms na yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod 'byung / /dpe gsum ldan 'di kun dang thun mong min/ /de phyir rgyu ni lam dang 'bras bur bcas/ /lam yang rgyu dang 'bras bu dang bcas shing / /'bras bu yang ni rgyu lam dang bcas pas/ /lhun grub sdom pa sngags kyi sdom pa yin/ /de nyid rgyu la ji ltar gnas pa dang / /lam gyi thog mar gang las thob pa dang / /bar du gang gis mngon du byed pa dang / /tha ma 'bras bu'i ngo bor 'gyur tshul dang / /dpe dang don gyi rab du dbye ba dang / /gnas sogs lnga yis gtan la dbab pa dang / /sna tshogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs bstan pa dang / /nyams len thams cad de nyid du 'dus dang / /snang ba thams cad de nyid du sdom sogs/ /rnam mang rgyud sde'i tshogs las gsungs pa'i don/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis bkral ba'i tshul/ /'khrul zad brgyud pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ /bshad par bya yis bskal bzang dga' bas nyon/ /ji ltar snang ba rang gi sems su sdom/ /sems nyid spros bral rang bzhin lhan skyes su/ /legs par sdom par rgyu la gnas pa yi/ /sdom pa yin par rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ /gzhir gnas dkyil 'khor bzhi la dbang bzhi yis/

/sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs tshe bla med kyi/ /sdom pa rdzogs pa rgyud sde 'og ma las/ /zab khyad yin par dbang gi rim pas shes/ /dam tshig nyi shu man ngag gnad drug sogs/ /rgyu dang dbang dang lam dang 'bras bu rnams/ /bzhi bzhir phye ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /man ngag mtha' dag 'di yi sgrub byed yin/ /sa bon de nyid tshogs gnyis bsags pa yi/ /skal ldan rnams la ye shes nyid du skye/ /gzhan la mngon gsal nyid du mi skye yang / /de tshe spong sems thob pa sdom pa yin/ /spong sems bum dbang nyid du thob snyam na/ /tha mal rnam rtog spong sems der thob kyang / /gya nom lhar zhen rnam rtog spong sems ni/ /mchog dbang gsum du thob kyi gzhan du min/ /rgyas gdab lnga dang rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang / /dam tshig gsum gyi brda don 'phrod pa'i tshe/ /chos can lnga po chos nyid dang bcas dang / /sgo gsum tha mal rnam rtog spong sems thob/ /gzhir gnas byang chub sems la bla ma yi/ /byang sems 'dres dang mas brtan bzhi pa dang / /de nyid tshig gis brda don 'phrod pa'i tshe/ /gya nom lhar zhen rnam rtog spong sems thob/ /ye shes skyes tshe spong sems gzhan yod dang / /rtsa ba'i ltung bar spong sems ma 'dus dang / /smin grol spang bya 'chol sogs skyon rnams kyis/ /mi sgrib rgyu mtshan ngag las shes par bya/ /de rjes dkyil 'khor de'am gzhan du'ang rung / /rgyu dbang bzhi dang lus dkyil dbang bzhi dang / /bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin brlabs rim gnyis sogs/ /thob pa'i sdom pa yang yang goms pa'i thabs/ /dbang gi rab dbye bcu gnyis gsungs pa dang / /lam dus dbang dang lam zab bla ma yis/ /rim gnyis bsgom pa med kyang dngos grub mchog /'grub par gsungs pa 'di la 'thad pa yin/ /dbang las byung ba thabs kyis goms pa yis/ /bde chen sgrib pa 'gags nas rang snang gi /ye shes skyes tshe shes bya ma lus pa/

/gsang gsum ngo bor sdom pa 'bras bu'i sdom/ /'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed dgos pas/ /lam gyi dus su shes bya ma lus pa/ /lha dang bde chen ngo bor bsgom pa ni/ /'bras bu'i sdom pa 'di yi sgrub byed yin/ /dbang dang lam las byung ba'i ye shes bzhi/ /so skye'i dus su dpe yi sdom pa yin/ /mthong ba'i lam nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar/ /don gyi sdom pa yin te phyag chen bzhin/ /gang du sdom dang spang bya gang sdom dang / /ji snyed sdom dang sdom pa'i ngo bo dang / /gang gis sdom pa don tshan rnam lnga yis/ /sdom gsum ma lus gtan la dbab par gsungs/ /skal ldan gang gis rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /sngags kyi sdom pa dbang gi ye shes dang / /lam gyi nyams myong phyag rgya chen po dang / /rang byung bde chen brjod bral lhan cig skyes/ /rang rig mkha' mnyam rdul bral stong pa nyid/ /zung 'jug 'gyur med lhun grub ma bcos pa/ /dbyer med shes nas rtse gcig sgrub pa de/ /gsang ba chen po'i rnal 'byor pa zhes bya/ /ye shes skyes tshe de dag sdom pa yi/ /ming gi rnam grangs yin kyang ma skyes na/ /spong sems tsam la de dag mi 'jug pas/ /khyab mnyam nyid du 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /mnyam par gzhag dang ma bzhag rnal 'byor bcus/ /dbang gi dus kyi sku bzhi'i sa bon nyid/ /bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed phyir bcu char yang / /sngags kyi sdom pa'i nyams len nyid du 'dus/ /snang ba'i dngos po rim pa dang por ni/ /lha ru sdom zhing de nyid gnyis pa'i tshe/ /bde chen ye shes nyid du sdom pa'i phyir/ /snang ba thams cad 'di ru sdom par gsungs/ /rgyud gsum kye yi rdo rjer sbyor tshul dang / /rgyud gsum dag pa gsum du sbyor tshul gyis/ /rgyud gsum sdom par sbyor tshul rtogs par 'gyur/ /'on kyang mtshan btags phye ba gnad du gces/ /dbang gi ye shes de yis snang ba la/ /rgyas 'debs phyir na phyag rgya chen po ste/

/snang ba thams cad ye shes de nyid du/ /'dus phyir sdom par kha sbyor rgyud las gsungs/ /spang bya 'bras bu rten dang brten pa yis/ /rim gnyis grang nges sgrub pa'i lung rigs kyis/ /lugs mchog 'di la sdom pa'ang rim gnyis kyi/ /sdom pa gnyis su nges pa'i grang nges 'grub/ /rtsa rgyud kha sbyor ye shes thig le dang / /lugs 'dir tshad mar gyur pa'i gzhung 'grel dang / /snying po rtse mo rgyal mtshan bzang po yi/ /mtha' can bla ma'i gsung rab 'dir sbyar bya/ /thug med skyon dang bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / /gsol btab tshig dang bum dbang cho ga dang / /thob mtshams 'ga' zhig la sogs skyon rnams kyis/ /lugs bzang 'di la gnod par ga la 'gyur/ /bdag gi bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /mdzad pa ji bzhin blo yi rim pa dang / /mtshams par ston phyir snod min rnams la gsang / /bla mas gnang na don 'di gzhan la spel/ /gzhan dag grags pa'i rjes 'brang mang smra na'ang / /dpyod ldan yid la nges pa'i grub mtha' ni/ /gnod byed tshad ma gcig gis bzlog 'gyur gyi/ /ltar snang bye bas bzlog par ga la 'gyur/ /mkhas pa snga ma'i legs bshad sun phyung nas/ /mi shes shes dang ma mthong mthong smra ba'i/ /bsam pa med kyang blo gros shar ri'i rtser/ /gnas lugs nyi ma shar tshe 'od zer 'byung / /sa glang sa gar mdo mkhar gnas su ni/ /zab don zab mo'i gnad kyi bdud rtsi 'di/ /rgyud gsum rgyud don smra ba de yis sbyar/ /dge tshogs dge ba'i sems kyis 'gro la sbyin/ /bdag kyang dengs nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /kun dga'i gsung rab bzang po rtag nyan cing / /dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchod byas nas/ /rtag tu 'gro la dam chos ston par shog /rnal 'byor chen po'i sdom pa'i gnad bye brag tu bshad pa zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun bla ma kun dga' bzang po yab sras rnams kyi bka' drin la brten nas rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i don la blo kha cung zad phyogs pa shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges sa mo glang gi lo sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi la dben gnas mdo mkhar chos rdzong dgon par sbyar ba'o//

//dge ba 'di yis dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod/ /bla med mchog gi bstan pa ni/ /dar rgyas yun ring gnas gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/ rnal 'byor chen po'i sdom pa'i gnad bye brag tu bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
